Kids Bible Class

Our Church Family Story

Community Church — Ashburn, Virginia
Who loves our church family?

“Love each other.”

John 15:12 (NIrV)

Jesus loves our church family!

Image 1

A long time ago, our church was very small.

Friends who loved Jesus met at a school… and even under a tent!

That was the start of our church family!

Image 2

Now kids come to CKids!

We sing. We play. We learn that Jesus loves us.

Big kids have fun with their friends at church too!

Image 3

Our church has a school too — Virginia Academy!

Kids learn and make friends.

Jesus loves the kids at our school!

Image 4

Our church helps people who need food.

We share bags of food with happy smiles.

Helping others is one way we love like Jesus!

Image 5

Friends meet in little groups to pray and talk.

Our church is 44 years old — and it is still growing!

Jesus loves our church family. You belong here!

What We Learn

Our church started small — just a few friends who loved Jesus. Now our church family is celebrating 44 years — and it is still growing! We sing, we learn, we help people, and we love each other. Jesus loves our church family.

For you: You are part of our church family. Jesus loves you!
